appearance.chooseDescription: Choose a theme published by the administrator. Your choice is saved to your account.
appearance.failed: Could not complete the request. Refresh and try again.
appearance.name: Name
appearance.cloneHint: Create a copy to change the colors of a built-in or plugin theme.
appearance.previewHint: Preview applies only to this card. Save to publish the changes.
appearance.adminDescription: Manage published themes, user availability and the panel default.
appearance.pluginHint: Theme packages use the existing Plugins installer. Only declarative colors and corner radius are accepted. Publish an installed theme here to make it available.
appearance.artworkUserDescription: Choose from artwork provided by the administrator. The live bot avatar is used automatically when available.
appearance.noArtwork: No artwork has been assigned yet. The built-in appearance remains active.
appearance.hierarchy: Automatic: service → application profile → Egg → category → Tyravex appearance. Custom administrator defaults take priority over repository artwork within the same layer. Egg updates do not overwrite custom variants.
appearance.artworkAdminDescription: Upload images, then assign banners and icons to Eggs, variants, categories or individual services. Multiple choices may be provided for each target.
appearance.libraryEmpty: Upload a PNG, JPEG or WebP image, then choose “Assign artwork” to make it available for a service.
appearance.uploadHint: PNG, JPEG or WebP, up to 5 MB. Images are converted to WebP without metadata.

overview.title: Administrative overview
overview.description: Services, infrastructure and installation availability at a glance.
overview.installationSeparate: Installation status is separate from application runtime.
overview.noAlerts: No issues detected in the sections you can access.
overview.telemetryHint: These are connection statuses. Host resource measurements are not currently available.
overview.systemHint: Data comes from this panel. Counts respect your permissions and refresh every 30 seconds.

appearance.uploadFailed: Could not upload the image. Check its format and the 5 MB limit.
appearance.eggArtworkDescription: The banner and icon are automatically used by services running this Egg. Supply them in the repository or assign custom variants in the Artwork library.
appearance.eggArtworkNoManifest: This Egg does not declare artwork. Assign custom images in the Artwork library or add an artwork section to a new Egg version.
appearance.eggArtworkNeedsSource: Artwork import requires an Egg from a commit-pinned repository. For file imports, assign custom images in the library.
appearance.eggArtworkReadOnly: Repository artwork. Assign a custom default variant to override it.
appearance.eggInheritance: Automatic: service → application profile → Egg → category → Tyravex appearance. User selection takes priority; banners and icons inherit separately.

errors.EGG_ARTWORK_SCHEMA_OUTDATED: The database schema must be updated before repository Egg artwork can be saved. An administrator must apply the Artwork migration and retry the download.
errors.EGG_ARTWORK_PIN_REQUIRED: Import the Egg from a commit-pinned repository.
errors.EGG_ARTWORK_DOWNLOAD_FAILED: Could not safely download Egg artwork.
errors.EGG_ARTWORK_HASH_MISMATCH: Artwork does not match the SHA-256 digest declared by the Egg.
errors.EGG_ARTWORK_SOURCE_READ_ONLY: Repository artwork is read-only. Assign a custom variant.
errors.ARTWORK_ASSET_IN_USE: The image is in use. Refresh the library and update assignments before removing it.
errors.ARTWORK_ASSET_NOT_FOUND: Image not found. Refresh the library.
errors.ARTWORK_VERSION_CONFLICT: The assignment has changed. Return to the library and open the latest version.
errors.ARTWORK_ASSET_REQUIRED: Choose at least a banner or an icon.
errors.INVALID_ARTWORK_CHOICE: Check the assignment name and settings.
errors.INVALID_ARTWORK_PROFILE: Choose an application profile belonging to the selected Egg.
errors.INVALID_ARTWORK_ASSET: The selected image is unavailable. Choose it again from the library.
errors.ARTWORK_CHOICE_NOT_FOUND: This assignment no longer exists. Refresh the list.

artworkUi.intro: Manage service banners and icons. Upload images to the library, assign them to targets and preview the result before saving.
artworkUi.repositoryHelp: Artwork supplied by Eggs is read-only. Preview it or create a custom variant; Egg updates will not overwrite your variant.
artworkUi.noRepository: No repository artwork. Add or update an Egg declaring a banner or icon.
artworkUi.libraryHelp: This library stores image files. Uploading does not automatically assign an image to a service; use Assign artwork.
artworkUi.noAssets: No images match the search. Upload an image to get started.
artworkUi.usedCannotDelete: The image is in use. Update its assignments first.
artworkUi.removeHelp: Remove “{{name}}”. Only images without assignments can be removed.
artworkUi.selectHint: Select a thumbnail or upload a new image.
artworkUi.uploadHint: Drop one image or choose it from your computer.
artworkUi.uploadDoesNotAssign: The image will be added to the library. Create an assignment to make it available to services.
artworkUi.previewHelp: Previewing a variant does not save changes. Banners and icons inherit separately. A live bot avatar may replace the fallback icon.
artworkUi.hiddenPreview: This variant is hidden. The preview shows its appearance, but users cannot select it.
artworkUi.sourceCopy: You are creating a custom variant. The repository source remains unchanged.
artworkUi.notFound: Assignment not found. Return to the library and refresh.
artworkUi.previewOnly: Appearance preview — controls do not operate a service.
artworkUi.noAssignments: No matching assignments. Add an assignment or change the filters.
artworkUi.downloadFailed: Could not download Egg artwork. Check its source and repository connection, then try again.
artworkUi.downloaded: Artwork downloaded. Refresh the list if this entry is still visible.
artworkUi.noRepositoryMatches: No artwork matches the selected filters. Clear filters to see all entries.
artworkUi.removeAssignmentHelp: Remove assignment “{{name}}”? Services using this variant will return to inherited artwork. Images will remain in the library.
artworkUi.removeSourceHelp: Remove downloaded assignment “{{name}}”? Services will return to inherited artwork. Repository and library files will remain unchanged. Artwork can be downloaded again; Egg synchronization may restore it.
artworkUi.isEnabledHelp: Allow users of matching services to select this artwork. Disabled artwork is not offered for selection.
artworkUi.isDefaultHelp: Use this artwork automatically for its target when the user has not selected another option. Banner and icon inherit separately.
